title: BE Fit Modern Pilates

services.name: pilates dallas
services.desc: BE Fit Modern Pilates in Allen sits on Garden Park Drive in north Collin County, minutes from Watters Creek, Allen Premium Outlets, and the Sam Rayburn Tollway. We opened the studio in September 2024 to bring 45-minute X-Former classes to Allen, McKinney, Plano, and Frisco. Our 45-minute X-Former classes are slow, controlled, and demanding. Continuous tension on the X-Former engages slow-twitch muscle fibers in a way that traditional reformer Pilates and high-impact cardio can’t match. Every class hits cardio, strength, balance, and core stability inside a single 45-minute block. Allen is one of the fastest-growing communities in north Texas. Anchored by Watters Creek and Allen Premium
